Read Elevation-Model Descriptors at Plot Coordinates

Source: R/terrain.R
resolve.terrain_descriptors.Rd

Reads four descriptors per plot from an elevation model: the elevation at the coordinate (bilinear between cell centres), the mean elevation over the 1 km square centred on it, the slope of the cell nearest the coordinate from its four edge neighbours (as Earth Engine's ee.Terrain.slope), and the inclination of the least-squares plane through the 1 km square. The elevation model is either a directory of elevation grids (a tiles.json and its float32 .npy tiles) or a terrain field file, the same tiles compressed into neural fields; both are read through one definition, so the two differ only by the field's reconstruction error.

Usage

resolve.terrain_descriptors(
  latitude,
  longitude,
  grids = NULL,
  field = NULL,
  device = "cpu"
)

Arguments

latitude, longitude

Plot coordinates in degrees (WGS84).

grids

Directory of elevation grids, or NULL.

field

Path of a terrain field file (neural or coded), or NULL. Give exactly one of grids and field.

device

With field: "cpu", "cuda" or "cuda:N".

Value

A data.frame with one row per plot: elevation and elevation_1km (m), slope and slope_1km (degrees); NA where the elevation model holds nothing.

See also

resolve.predict.suite() with terrain.
